text:
Mina: Hi all 10 I'm handing in my resignation today. Proposed last day 2025-09-12. Can someone start offboarding? Need benefits end date, COBRA timeline, where to return company YubiKey and laptop, and visa paperwork notes (Im on a work visa).
Sam (People Ops): Sorry to hear, Mina. Quick answers: benefits end EOD your last day (2025-09-12). COBRA packet mailed/emailed within 14 business days; election window usually 60 days. We'll include carrier contacts and estimated premiums. For visa, People Ops + Legal will prepare an employment verification letter with dates and final salary—expect a draft in 2 business days.
Mina: Thanks. I also need to confirm if COBRA premiums are billed retroactively to 2025-09-13 or start from payment date?
Sam (People Ops): COBRA is retroactive to the day after coverage ends (2025-09-13). When you elect, the first premium often covers the retroactive period. Exact billing schedule depends on the carrier; details included in packet.
IT-bot: Please confirm asset info so we can generate a prepaid return label. Device wipe scheduled the business day after last active day unless manager requests otherwise.
```
asset_tag: RDN-08877
device: MacBook Pro 14"
serial: SN-PL4K2
```
Mina: I'll ship the laptop. Also have a company YubiKey 12 I'll drop in SF locker if you send the code.
Sam (People Ops): We'll DM the locker code or send a UPS label. Exit interview: 30-min video or 20-min call? Morning slots the week after your last day available.
Mina: 30-min video morning preferred.
Security: We'll run access review on 2025-09-13 09:00 PT and revoke SSO/org keys after audit. Please remove any personal tokens from repos and dotfiles now.
Mina: Will scrub personal tokens and upload a short runbook for my services by EOD.
Sam (People Ops): Exit interview scheduled for 2025-09-16 10:00 PT; invite sent. Payroll notified for final paycheck and PTO payout. COBRA materials + asset return instructions will be emailed within 14 business days after 9/12. DM if anything urgent.
Mina: Thanks everyone 10 appreciate the help.
